content: प्रपद् €4 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To enter upon, set forward, set foot in. .²2 .³({%a%}) To go to or towards, approach, resort or attain to, reach; तां जन्मने शैलवधूं प्रपेदे <ls>Ku. 1. 21</ls>; (क्षितीशं) कौत्सः प्रपेदे वरतन्तुशिष्यः <ls>R. 5. 1</ls>; <ls>Bk. 4. 1</ls>; <ls>Ki. 1. 9</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">11. 16</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 11</ls>. .³({%b%}) To take shelter or refuge with, flee to for safety, submit; शरणार्थमन्यां कथं प्रपत्स्ये त्वयि दीप्यमाने <ls>R. 14. 64</ls>. .²3 To go or come to a particular state, arrive at, attain to, arrive at or be in a particular condition; रेणुः प्रपेदे पथि पङ्कभावम् <ls>R. 16. 30</ls>; मुहूर्तकर्णोत्पलतां प्रपेदे <ls>Ku. 7. 81</ls>; बाल्यात्परं साथ वयः प्रपेदे <ls>Ku. 1. 31</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">5. 24</ls>; ईदृशीमवस्थां प्रपन्नोस्मि <ls>Ś. 5</ls>; ऋषिनिकरैरिति संशयः प्रपेदे <ls>Bv. 4. 33</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 30</ls>. .²4 To get, find, secure, obtain, attain to; partake of, share in; सहकार न प्रपेदे मधुपेन भवत्समं जगति <ls>Bv. 1. 21</ls>; कान्तं वपुर्व्योमचरम् प्रपेदे <ls>R. 5. 51</ls>. .²5 To behave or act towards, deal with; किं प्रपद्यते वैदर्भः <ls>M. 1</ls> ‘what does he propose to do’; पश्यामो मयि किं प्रपद्यते <ls>Amaru. 24</ls>. .²6 To admit, allow, agree or consent to; प्रपन्नं साधयन्नर्थम् <ls>Y. 2. 40</ls>. .²7 To draw near, come on, approach (as time <ab>&c.</ab>). .²8 To be going on, to proceed. .²9 To take effect, thrive, prosper. .²10 To throw oneself down, fall down (at anotherʼs feet). .²11 <ab>Ved.</ab> To attack, assault.
